test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Why do many types of trees shed old leaves?

options.text: Because a tree can support only a certain number of leaves
Because the cells die due to old age of the tree
Because old leaves are broken off due to strong winds
Because the cells become packed with waste materials

solution: The correct answer is __**Because the cells become packed with waste materials**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__</span&g
